factions.name: Oakhaven Folk
factions.description: The farmers, tradesfolk and families of Oakhaven, the eastern grain hub. Help them and doors open, prices drop and people talk.

factions.name: The Salt-Menders
factions.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the forerunners of book 3's Salt-Menders (the refugees of the Western Coast after the exodus); their tunnels and their work in the game's time are GAME-ONLY
factions.description: Folk of the Alliance who meet in old tunnels and mend what the Concord breaks. They move people the Concord wants. In years to come, their name will go west with the refugees.

factions.name: Preservationist Guild
factions.description: Matriarch Vala Solari's guild. Its Wardens wear green and brown and armour of living vine, and they stand against the Spoke.

factions.name: Ash-Walkers
factions.description: Survivors who live along the Wasting and fight what comes out of it with salt. Their caves are on the Eastern Ridge.

factions.name: Sandthrone
factions.description: Mercenaries from the wastes, often hired by the Concord but with their own agenda. They'll sell you a contract if the coin is right.

factions.name: High Concord
factions.description: The Council in Argentis: 'Order at any cost.' Its collectors and Investigation Bureau do not bargain with the likes of you.
